class.name: VirtualGeometryWind
class.brief_description: Procedural foliage wind skeleton attached to a [VirtualGeometryData] resource.
class.description: Stores a compact procedural wind skeleton for virtualized foliage assets: one trunk bone (index [code]0[/code]) plus up to [constant MAX_BRANCH_BONES] ([code]8[/code]) branch bones, for at most [constant MAX_BONES] ([code]9[/code]) bones per asset, together with a conservative [member max_sway] cull bound. When [member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/foliage_wind] is enabled, NextGeo shaders evaluate every bone's sway transform directly on the GPU from [World3D] wind parameters ([member World3D.wind_direction], [member World3D.wind_strength], [member World3D.wind_gust_frequency]), the frame time, and each instance's world transform, allocating zero bytes of per-instance skin palette arena memory.

method.name: add_bone
method.description: Appends a procedural wind bone (up to [constant MAX_BONES]) with its bind-pose pivot [param rest_position], bone [param axis], [param stiffness] in [code][0, 1][/code], phase offset [param sway_phase], local sway amplitude bound [param max_sway], [param lever_length], part [param mass], and aerodynamic [param wind_catch].

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears all procedural wind bones and resets [member max_sway] to [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: compute_bone_physics_from_geometry
method.description: Computes per-bone [member bone_masses] and [member bone_wind_catches] from bind-pose geometry. When triangle [param indices] are supplied, distributes triangle surface area and lateral wind-catch exposure across bones weighted by [param bones] and [param weights]; otherwise derives a point-cloud estimate from vertex distribution around each bone.

method.name: compute_vertex_skinning
method.description: Computes four-influence bone indices and normalized weights for each bind-pose vertex position in [param positions] against this wind skeleton. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]"bones"[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]) and [code]"weights"[/code] ([PackedFloat32Array]).

method.name: generate_from_geometry
method.description: Generates one trunk bone and up to [constant MAX_BRANCH_BONES] branch bones from bind-pose vertex [param positions] distributed along [param trunk_axis] and radial azimuth sectors. When [param max_sway] is negative, a conservative default sway bound is derived from the mesh height.

method.name: generate_from_skeleton_data
method.description: Derives a procedural wind skeleton (one trunk bone plus up to [constant MAX_BRANCH_BONES] branch bones) from an imported skeleton's rest bone positions and parent indices. Returns a remap table mapping each source bone index to a wind bone index in [code][0, get_bone_count() - 1][/code], or an empty array on failure.

method.name: get_bone_count
method.description: Returns the number of procedural wind bones in this resource (at most [constant MAX_BONES]).

members.member: Minimum projection along [member trunk_axis] across the asset's bind-pose vertices.
Unit-length local axes for each procedural wind bone.

Effective lever lengths (distance from each bone's rest pivot to its farthest influenced vertex, clamped to at least [code]0.25[/code]) used to convert sway amplitude into bend angle without exceeding [member max_sway].

Per-bone effective part mass derived at import from bind-pose geometry and used by dynamic wind simulation ([member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/dynamic_wind]) to scale spring inertia. Defaults to [code]1.0[/code] for entries omitted by older assets.
Maximum local-space sway amplitude in meters for each procedural wind bone.
Bind-pose pivot positions in mesh-local space for each procedural wind bone.
Per-bone stiffness values in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]. Higher stiffness reduces sway amplitude and slows oscillation frequency.
Per-bone oscillation phase offsets in radians to desynchronize branch motion.

Per-bone aerodynamic wind-catch (drag/sail area) factor derived at import from bind-pose geometry and used by dynamic wind simulation ([member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/dynamic_wind]) to scale slow sway forcing and fast flutter amplitude. Defaults to [code]1.0[/code] for entries omitted by older assets.

Conservative local-space sway bound in meters used to inflate CPU and GPU instance, cluster, and virtual shadow map culling bounds when [member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/foliage_wind] is enabled.
Maximum projection along [member trunk_axis] across the asset's bind-pose vertices.
Primary trunk axis in mesh-local space (typically [code]Vector3(0, 1, 0)[/code]).

constants.constant: Maximum number of procedural branch bones per asset (in addition to the trunk bone).
Maximum total number of procedural wind bones per asset (1 trunk bone plus up to [constant MAX_BRANCH_BONES] branch bones).
Number of vertex skinning bone influences written for procedural wind assets.
